Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency and batching story. We want to launch a scoped 90-day pilot with a single team (approx 2M tokens / month). Our procurement team has a strict PO policy but for small, short pilots they sometimes accept invoice-only arrangements.

Before we start the paperwork: can Redwood accept an invoice-only onboarding for a pilot capped at EUR 6,500 total, with standard T+30 payment? If not, what evidence and timelines would procurement need to speed a PO setup?

Hi Alicia — great to hear and glad the demo landed. Short answer: we can support an invoice-only path for pilots under certain limits, but we need procurement sign-off and a small evidence packet.

Proposed guardrails we typically use for an "invoice-only pilot":
- Pilot cap: EUR 7,500 total (one invoice or split monthly),
- Duration: up to 90 days,
- Standard net terms (T+30) with one-week grace for first invoice,
- Required evidence: vendor W-8/W-9 equivalent, proof of address, basic SOC 2 summary (if available), and a short SOW/pilot scope.

If PolarWave can provide the minimal evidence checklist, I will route to Procurement with a request for a temporary no-PO path. Copying Laura (Finance ops) and Sean (Sales leadership) so we can expedite.

If Procurement requires PO regardless, procurement timelines are usually 7–10 business days from intake completion.

Next steps:
1) Alicia — upload the intake form + any SOC/supplier docs to the Drive link below.
2) Laura — can you confirm internal acceptance criteria and whether we need an exception ticket?
3) Sean — FYI on pilot approval and revenue recognition path.

Markus
Head of Strategic GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Markus / Sean — quick ops note from Finance: we can approve a temporary invoice-only lane for a pilot under EUR 7,500 if the vendor provides the items below and signs a short payment terms acknowledgment. We'll create a one-off supplier record flagged as "pilot-invoice-only" and close it after settlement.

Required items from PolarWave (minimal set):
- Completed vendor intake form (received)
- Legal entity verification (company registry excerpt)
- Primary billing contact + invoice email (finance@polarwave.ai)
- Bank details (IBAN + BIC) and VAT id
- Brief SOC 2 summary or statement of no-SOC (if not available)
- Signed pilot SOW (one paragraph scope + cap)

Operational constraints:
- No automatic provisioning of dedicated invoices to product team; Finance will issue the ledger code and payment path.
- Pilot supplier record expires automatically after 95 days from approval to enforce review.

Alicia — if you can drop the registry excerpt and bank details to the Drive link in the next 24 hours we can get Procurement to issue a "no-PO authorization" memo by end of day tomorrow.

I'll attach the evidence checklist and the short SOW template.
